metadata.title: LeTRON - Green Technology, Smart Operations
metadata.description: Vietnam's leading technology solutions for waste-to-resource conversion and green construction materials.

hero.description2: and technology into the foundation of a sustainable Net Zero ecosystem.

lesb.description: Digitizing technical infrastructure for transport works, seaports, and modular industrial structures.

lese.title: LeSE — SMART ENERGY
lese.description: Integrating solar power, wind power, and BESS energy storage stations for Net Zero operations.

lesm.title: LeSM — SMART MOBILITY
lesm.description: Smart EV charging infrastructure, automated battery-swap stations, and optimized green logistics systems.

legm.title: LeGM — GREEN MATERIALS
legm.description: Optimized-mix ready-mix concrete, unfired brick, green steel, and seawater-erosion-resistant concrete.

lesc.title: LeSC — SMART CITY
lesc.description: Smart eco-city planning models and circular eco-industrial park development.

about.introParagraph1: LETRON is a new-generation industrial group, pioneering the application of digital technology to restructure the entire value chain from resources and production to infrastructure and energy.
about.introParagraph2: Unlike traditional business models, LETRON is built as a unified operating platform, where data, artificial intelligence, and physical assets are tightly connected through the LeOS operating system. Here, what was once considered "waste" is redefined as valuable resources, creating a sustainable, globally scalable circular economic loop.
about.visionParagraph: LETRON aims to bring Vietnamese intelligence and technology to the global stage, shaping a new standard for the industry — where economic growth goes hand in hand with environmental restoration.
about.missionIntro: We apply the LeOS and LeLe AI platforms to:
missionPoints: Turn industrial waste into high-value materials
